description: This file defines the CordRepRingReader class, which provides navigation over CordRepRing data structures in the Abseil C++ library. It includes methods for accessing, moving through, and seeking within ring buffer data related to string representations.

classes.name: CordRepRingReader
classes.description: A class providing navigation and access methods over a CordRepRing data structure, including moving to next chunks, seeking to offsets, and resetting the reader.

methods.name: operator bool
methods.description: Checks if the reader is not empty.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Returns the current node index within the ring.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the total length of the ring buffer.

methods.name: consumed
methods.description: Returns the total bytes consumed so far.

methods.name: remaining
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes remaining beyond the current position.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the reader to an empty state.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the reader to the start of a given ring buffer.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Advances to the next chunk in the ring buffer.

methods.name: Seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specific offset within the ring buffer, returning a string view into that position.
